correctness: 57 native tests with Metal validation; exact real-model probe-on/off logits, routes and persistent state; 185 Python tests.
limitations: Short histories and two diagnostic pairs do not qualify ordinary or sustained performance.
GPU probes affect hardware/cache state; endpoint samples are not a continuous device trace.
hypothesis: A fixed resident GPU operation can reveal device execution changes around slow conversations.
expected_effect: Boundary GPU time would increase alongside a reproduced later GPU slowdown.
controlled_change: Add a bounded fixed Q8 operation before and after each whole conversation, outside request timing.
outcome: Three baseline conversations completed in 63.46 to 66.10 seconds; post-conversation probe medians were 500.00 to 501.92 microseconds. The earlier large slowdown was not reproduced.
smallest_experiment: Retain the optional probe. A future reproduced late slowdown needs evidence from the affected interval before assigning a cause.
